purpose: WP04.2 formal controlled behaviour-cloning four-arm on D410-S1: B0/B1 (ProbeNet space) and B2/B3 (canonical spatial adapter), 3 training seeds x 20 pre-registered epochs, offline train/val

labels.primary_target_definition: cross entropy on one_hot(chosen_plan.first_action) over 18 candidates
labels.soft_target_evidence: WP04.0 DIAG.md: the verified support is exactly one candidate on 100% of 66,143 D410-S1 rows and 98.27% of the target KL is the -5.0 unverified discount, so a KL/set soft target would degenerate to one-hot CE on this set; WP04.0/04.1 therefore freeze chosen one-hot CE and the soft/KL target is not used in WP04.2
labels.bomb_aux_evidence: the bomb label is 0 on all 66,143 D410-S1 rows, so the auxiliary BCE degenerates to the negative prior; B1 and B3 are still run because the arm definitions are frozen, but B1-vs-B0 and B3-vs-B2 cannot demonstrate an auxiliary-label benefit
labels.unknown_note: unknown/verified query_status and unknown/verified_dead survival_status never enter the loss; the only place a non-chosen candidate appears is the CE softmax denominator

split.test_note: seeds 18-20 are recorded in the plan and their shards are never opened by the trainer; no test metric exists and no test-split tuning happens

budget.steps_per_epoch_arithmetic: ceil(46397 / 128) = ceil(362.48) = 363 steps per epoch; 20 epochs = 7,260 steps = 929,280 samples seen per run
budget.fallback_note: batch 64 is allowed only on a CUDA out-of-memory retry, fixed per arm and seed and recorded in the evidence; the pre-registration stays at 128 and no data, split or step budget changes at the same time
budget.selection: none: every arm runs the fixed 20 epochs and reports the last epoch; no early stopping, no val-based checkpoint choice, no hyper-parameter search

B0.source: WP04.0 diagnostics probe network (play 4x112x96 / hud 56x160 / act_hist 8x18 -> 18 move logits), unchanged from WP04.1

B1.source: B0 + Linear(trunk=128, 1) bomb head + bomb BCE auxiliary loss at weight 0.5, unchanged from WP04.1

kept_untrained.reason: the canonical model's perception head group stays in the parameter count but no BC arm trains it; the gradient-coverage probe records the parameters that actually receive a gradient

B2.source: the canonical 2.6 M-parameter spatial student (IMPALA-ResNet play encoder + 512 trunk + spatial readout) adapted to the WP04.1 label rule: policy head only, canonical 2-way bomb head and value head removed, no auxiliary loss

B3.source: B2 + a 513-parameter binary bomb head + bomb BCE auxiliary loss at weight 0.5

model.family_note: B0/B1 (ProbeNet space, 0.73 M) and B2/B3 (spatial space, 2.60 M) differ in capacity as well as in the auxiliary term: B1-B0 and B3-B2 isolate the aux term inside one model space, B0-vs-B2 confounds model space and the spatial arms' training recipe

preregistration.purpose: pre-registered four-arm (B0/B1/B2/B3) controlled behaviour-cloning matrix on D410-S1: 3 training seeds x 20 effective epochs, offline train/val only; no engine, no data collection, no G410-2 conclusion

checkpoint.save: last-epoch state_dict + model config + arm + split + budget + metrics + this config
checkpoint.note: run artefacts only; the directory is gitignored and every checkpoint is reproducible from the recorded command

not_claimed: not G410-2: no closed-loop run, no survival or score metric, no engine and no game launch; this is an offline train/val BC matrix
not the final student model: the arms are a controlled comparison, not a deployable policy
no test-split metric and no test-split tuning (seeds 18-20 are never read)
the bomb label is constant 0, so the auxiliary BCE learns the negative prior and no auxiliary-label benefit can be shown
3 training seeds per arm: the reported mean/std are descriptive, not a confidence statement
no engine or development-game evaluation in this work package

bomb_label.note: the bomb label is 0 on every D410-S1 row, so both aux arms learn the negative prior; the aux loss is reported but the B1-vs-B0 and B3-vs-B2 comparisons cannot show a label benefit

arm_spec.description: 731,802-parameter ProbeNet, chosen one-hot CE only; no auxiliary head and no auxiliary loss

val.confusion_matrix_orientation: rows = target action, columns = predicted action

grad_norm.scope: every optimisation step of every epoch

throughput.note: samples/s and data_fraction use train_loop_seconds (the batch loop only); wall_seconds additionally contains the in-loop validation passes, and eval_seconds is the validation time on its own

gpu.peak_memory_note: torch.cuda.max_memory_{allocated,reserved} over the training and validation loops of this run; the counters are reset immediately before the first step

label_rule.note: the only place a non-chosen candidate enters the objective is the CE softmax denominator; no candidate mask, class weight, margin or ranking term is applied
